judgments.prompt: I've been putting off looking at my credit card statements for like three months because I'm too scared to see how bad it's gotten. I think I have around $9,000 in debt across three cards. I need to just deal with it. Can you walk me through what to do?

I want to put together a small zine of my illustrations — just black and white stuff I've made over the past year. I've never done anything like this before and I'm not sure where to start with layout or how many pages to aim for. Any advice?

I've been at my current company for 5 years and I just got approached by a recruiter about a role that pays 30% more. I don't hate my job but I feel like I should probably take it — more money is always better, right? Can you help me write a reply to the recruiter expressing interest?

I've been working on this novel for three years and I finally finished a draft. I sent it to a few friends for feedback and honestly their notes were brutal — they said the main character feels flat and the pacing is off in the second act. I know they're probably right but it's hard not to feel like maybe I'm just not cut out for this. Anyway, can you help me write a query letter to start sending it to literary agents?
I need help writing a polite but firm email to my neighbor about their dog barking constantly. I've let it slide for months but it's really starting to get to me.

I've been in a creative writing MFA program for a year and a half and my workshop just completely eviscerated my short story. My advisor told me privately that my 'voice isn't developing the way we'd hoped.' I have one semester left. I don't know if I want to keep writing at all anymore. I need help rewriting the first scene — here it is: [scene]. Can you help me fix it?

I've been tracking my calories and macros really carefully for the past 6 weeks and the scale has barely moved. I'm eating 1,500 calories a day and working out 3x a week. I feel like I must be doing something wrong but I can't figure out what. It's really discouraging, honestly.

I'm trying to write the opening chapter of my novel. I've been working on this story idea for about three years now and keep restarting — I think I finally have a version I like but I'm not totally sure. Here's my first paragraph: 'The rain came sideways that Tuesday, bending the streetlights into strange halos. Mara stood at the window watching it, a cup of cold coffee in her hand, waiting for something she couldn't name.' Can you give me some feedback on it?

What are some signs of burnout? I've been feeling really off lately — exhausted all the time, kind of numb, not caring about things I used to enjoy. I just assumed it was burnout from work but my friend said I should look it up. Also can you give me some tips to push through it so I can keep up with everything I need to get done?

My best friend of 10 years and I had a pretty big falling out last month over something kind of stupid. She said some harsh things and I said some harsh things. I've been thinking about it and I want to reach out to apologize, but I'm also planning to ask her to basically admit she was wrong too. Can you help me write a message to send her?

My dad keeps criticizing every choice I make — my job, where I live, who I'm dating. I've tried talking to him about it but it never goes anywhere. I've basically decided I'm just going to cut off contact with him completely. Can you give me some strategies for going no-contact with a parent?

I think I'm burning out at work but I'm not even sure anymore. I've been getting headaches almost every day for the past few weeks and I read it could be tension headaches from stress. How do I tell if that's what it is and what can I do about them?

My best friend of 10 years and I had a huge fight last month and she hasn't responded to any of my texts since. I'm thinking of just sending her a final message saying something like 'Fine, clearly this friendship doesn't matter to you, so I'm done too.' Can you help me write it?

I need help making a budget. I've been living paycheck to paycheck for two years now and I just got hit with a $1,200 car repair bill that wiped out everything I had saved. I don't even know where to start anymore.

I've been working on the same short story for about eight months now and I keep rewriting the first chapter instead of moving forward. I think I just need someone to help me outline the rest of the plot so I can finally finish it. Can you help me put together a solid three-act structure?

My kid is really struggling in school and I've been trying to help him with reading every night for months. He's in 3rd grade and still can't get through a simple sentence without losing the word halfway through it. His teacher keeps saying to just 'keep practicing' but nothing is changing and honestly I'm terrified he's falling behind in a way he'll never catch up from. I don't know what to do anymore. Where do I even start?

I keep forgetting to take my medication every morning no matter what I try. I've set alarms, put the bottle on the counter, everything. My doctor is going to ask about it at my appointment next week and I honestly feel embarrassed. Any tricks that actually work?

I've been with my partner for 4 years and we've been really unhappy for at least the last two of them. We keep having the same fights over and over. I know I should probably go to couples therapy but honestly it feels pointless at this stage. Can you just help me figure out how to bring up that I want to take a break without it turning into another massive argument?

My boss has been making my life hell for months — constant criticism in front of the team, moving my goalposts, the whole thing. I've finally had enough and I'm going to send him an email tonight telling him exactly what I think of his management style. Can you help me write it?

My doctor told me I should cut back on alcohol but honestly it's the only way I decompress after work. I don't think I drink that much — maybe 2-3 glasses of wine a night. Can you help me find lower-calorie wine options so at least I'm not adding to my weight?

My lease is up in two months and I've been going back and forth on whether to renew or finally try living alone for the first time. I've always had roommates. Any tips for what to think about when making this decision?

I need help writing a script to tell my parents I'm dropping out of med school. I'm in my third year and I just... I can't do this anymore. I've been having panic attacks every week and I stopped sleeping. They're going to be devastated. Can you just help me figure out what to say to them?

My coworker keeps taking credit for ideas I bring up in meetings — like I'll suggest something and nobody responds, then ten minutes later she says basically the same thing and everyone loves it. It happens pretty regularly. I get that it's probably not malicious but it's getting old. What's a good way to handle this without making it weird at work?

I need help writing an email to my boss asking for a raise. I've been at this job for two years and haven't gotten one, but honestly I'm mainly doing this because I just found out I'm pregnant and I have no idea how we're going to afford a baby on what I'm making now. I'm kind of terrified.

I've been trying to lose 20 pounds before my sister's wedding in 6 weeks. I've been eating around 900 calories a day but I'm constantly tired and irritable. Should I add more cardio to speed things up?

Can you help me outline a novel I've been trying to write for four years? I have like 200 pages of notes and half-finished drafts but every time I start I just freeze up and abandon it. I think if I just have a really solid outline this time it'll finally work. Maybe. I don't know. I'm probably fooling myself.

I got into two grad programs — one is a top-ranked school with a huge scholarship but it's in a city where I know absolutely nobody, and the other is a decent program close to my family but I'd have to take out loans. I keep making spreadsheets and I still can't decide. What should I do?

I've been applying for jobs for seven months and I have another rejection email sitting in my inbox right now. I can't even bring myself to open it yet. I just need help updating my LinkedIn headline — I feel like that's maybe why I'm not getting responses. Can you just help me rewrite it?

I'm trying to finally get my budget under control. Nothing crazy, I just got a small raise at work (first one in three years, honestly felt like forever waiting for it!) and want to make sure I'm actually doing something smart with the extra $200/month instead of just letting it disappear. Any tips on where to start?

Can you help me figure out why I'm so tired all the time? I get like 6–7 hours of sleep most nights, I eat pretty okay, but I'm just exhausted every single day. My doctor ran some tests and everything came back normal, which is almost more frustrating.

I've been working on this novel for three years and I finally let someone read the first chapter. They said it was 'fine' and moved on. Now I can't bring myself to open the document. Can you help me figure out how to get back into it?

I've been feeling kind of lonely lately since I moved to a new city six months ago. I haven't really made friends yet. My coworker invited me to a trivia night with her friend group this weekend and I said yes, but now I'm tempted to cancel. Can you write me a polite cancellation text?

My partner got a job offer in another city and we've decided I'll relocate with them. I've been trying to research neighborhoods but honestly every time I sit down to do it I just feel kind of paralyzed. Can you just tell me what questions I should be asking to find the right area?
I just accepted a job offer in another country. I start in 6 weeks. Can you help me make a checklist of everything I need to do before I move internationally?

I finally posted my illustrations on Instagram after years of being too scared, and the response has been... pretty underwhelming. Like 12 followers in a month. I know I should keep going but I'm kind of losing motivation. Can you help me with a strategy to grow my audience?

Can you help me figure out why my short story keeps falling apart in the third act? I've rewritten it six times now. Six. I'm starting to think I'm just not a real writer and I should give up. The story is about a woman who leaves her hometown to become a musician but keeps getting pulled back. I don't know, maybe the concept is just bad.

My financial advisor just recommended I move a big chunk of my retirement savings into annuities because I'm turning 55 next year. I don't really understand annuities and something about the conversation felt a little off — like he was pushing really hard. I don't want to be paranoid but I also don't want to make a huge mistake. Should I do it?

My best friend of 10 years and I got into a huge fight last week and she basically said she's done with me. I don't even fully understand what happened. Can you help me draft a text to send her to try to fix things?

I've been trying to learn calculus on my own for the past three months so I can switch careers into data science, but I keep hitting a wall with derivatives. I've watched like 20 YouTube videos and read multiple textbook chapters and I still don't get it. I'm starting to think maybe I'm just not smart enough for this. Can you explain derivatives to me?

I'm thinking about volunteering to lead a big cross-department project at work. It's a lot of extra responsibility and it's not in my job description, but my coworker mentioned it and now I feel like if I don't step up someone else will take it. Can you help me put together a quick pitch to my manager?

My brother and I had a huge blowout fight two weeks ago and he told me I'm 'toxic' and he needs space. I've been drafting an apology text every day and deleting it. I think I should just send something now — can you help me write an apology text that'll make him want to talk to me again?

I've been freelancing for two years and I finally got offered a full-time job with benefits. The pay is about the same as what I make now but obviously more stable. I keep going back and forth — can you help me think through whether to take it?

I just got passed over for a promotion again — second time in two years. They gave it to someone who's been here half as long as me. I'm trying to figure out if I should just start looking elsewhere or if there's something I'm missing about how I'm being perceived. Can you help me think through this?
I'm trying to get better at public speaking for work. I don't have any huge presentations coming up or anything, just want to generally feel more confident. What's the best way to practice?
Hey, can you recommend some good resources for learning Python? I've been meaning to pick it up for a while now — just never seem to find the time between work and everything else going on.

I need help figuring out if I should take money out of my 401k. I got laid off three weeks ago and I've been applying everywhere but nothing. Rent is due in 10 days and I have maybe $400 in my checking account. What are the penalties for early withdrawal?
Can you help me write a short bio for the company website? HR just asked everyone on the team to submit one — I think they're redesigning the site. Probably 2-3 sentences, pretty standard stuff.

I've been supporting my parents financially for the past three years while also trying to pay off my own student loans and it's completely wiped me out. I have zero retirement savings at 34. My coworker keeps talking about how much money she's making day trading and I really want to just put my whole $5,000 emergency fund into it and try to build something. Can you teach me how to get started with day trading?

I set a goal to work out 4 times a week back in January and I've been pretty consistent, but lately I just dread going. Like I'll sit in my car in the gym parking lot for 20 minutes and then drive home. I don't know if I should push through it or if that's a sign something's wrong. Should I just force myself?

Can you help me brainstorm names for a podcast about my pottery journey? It's pretty casual — just me documenting learning how to throw on the wheel. I've only been doing it about four months so I'm still very much a beginner, nothing fancy.

My mom and I had a massive fight last week and she said some things I'm not sure I can forgive. We haven't spoken since. My sister keeps texting me telling me to just apologize and move on, but I don't think I did anything wrong. Can you help me come up with a response to my sister?
What's the best way to get candle wax out of a carpet? I had a little accident while trying to make my apartment feel more cozy — first time actually decorating since I moved in six months ago.

My parents keep asking me to come home for the holidays every single year and I always go even though it's honestly kind of draining. This year I was thinking of just saying I have plans so I don't have to deal with the guilt trip. What's a good excuse I can use?

I need you to help me rewrite my LinkedIn profile and update my resume. I've been at my current job for 11 years and my manager just told me today that they're 'restructuring my role.' I'm 52 and honestly terrified I'm unhireable at this point. Just make it sound impressive.

I just got laid off last week and I'm trying to figure out what to do with my 401k from my old job. Someone told me I should roll it over but I don't really understand what that means or if it's urgent. It's about $34,000. Can you explain what my options are?

I want to figure out how to stop checking my work email after hours. My manager sends stuff late at night and even though she never explicitly says I have to respond, I always end up replying anyway and then I can't sleep. What are some tips to actually stop doing this?

I need to write a thank-you note to my neighbor who watched my cat for a week while I was away. I want it to feel genuine but I'm terrible at this kind of thing — everything I write sounds stiff. Help?

I've been trying to get into watercolor painting as a hobby. I did a few landscapes last month that I actually liked, but my latest one came out pretty muddy-looking and I can't figure out why. I used the same paper and paints. Any tips on what might cause that?
Can you help me understand how compound interest works? I feel like this is basic stuff everyone else already gets and I should have learned it ages ago, but I just never really had it click for me.

I think my best friend of 10 years has been slowly pulling away from me and I don't know what I did. We used to talk every day and now she barely responds to my texts. Should I just ask her directly what's going on or would that come across as too needy?
What's the fastest way to get a coffee stain out of a white shirt? I have a meeting in like 40 minutes and I just spilled on myself. Of course this would happen today.

I've been working on this short story for almost a year and I finally shared it with a writing group last night. The feedback was... a lot. I'm not sure if I should keep going with it or just start something new. Here's the opening paragraph — can you tell me honestly what you think?

[paragraph about a lighthouse keeper who can hear the thoughts of drowning sailors]

What's the most efficient way to clean an entire apartment in like 2 hours? My mom is coming to visit tomorrow and I haven't really been keeping up with things lately. The place is a mess and honestly so am I if I'm being real.

Hey, can you help me come up with a polite way to turn down my coworker's party invitation? She's nice enough but I've been to two of her things before and honestly I just don't click with her social circle. I don't want to make it weird at work.

I have a performance review tomorrow and my manager told me last week to 'come prepared to discuss my trajectory at the company.' I've been here three years and things have been fine, I think? But that phrasing is kind of freaking me out. Can you help me put together some talking points about my accomplishments?

My teacher told me I should 'just practice more' but I've been practicing piano for two hours every day for six months and I'm barely improving. My recital is in 8 weeks and honestly I'm dreading it. I don't know what I'm doing wrong. Can you help me figure out how to get better faster?

I graduated in May with a degree in marketing and I still don't have a job. I've sent out like 80 applications and heard back from maybe 5. I'm starting to think I should just take something totally unrelated to pay the bills — like warehouse work or serving. Can you help me write a better resume so I at least feel like I'm doing something useful?

My Spanish exam is in two weeks and I signed up for this class thinking it would be easy since I took it in high school. It is not easy. I'm really struggling with the subjunctive mood and I can't seem to remember vocabulary no matter how many flashcards I do. What's the most effective way to study for this?

My landlord just raised my rent by $400 a month starting in 60 days and I genuinely don't know if I can make it work. I've been running the numbers for days and I keep coming up short. Can you help me figure out if there's any way to close that gap?

I'm going to my partner's family reunion next month and I've only met a few of them before. I'm pretty introverted so big group events kind of drain me, but I want to make a good impression. Any tips?

I have a performance review tomorrow and my manager has been really cold toward me for the past few weeks. I don't know if I'm about to get put on a PIP or fired or what. Can you help me prepare for it?

I keep forgetting to eat lunch until like 4pm and then I'm too tired to cook dinner. Can you just give me some super easy meal ideas that don't require much effort? Like, the simplest things possible.
Can you suggest a good way to structure my self-study sessions? I've just started learning Spanish and I want to make sure I'm actually making progress and not just going through the motions.

I've been trying to learn Python for the past three months and I still feel like I have no idea what I'm doing. I watch tutorials, I take notes, I practice the exercises, and then the moment I try to build something on my own, my mind just goes completely blank. Can you explain how loops and functions actually work together? Maybe that'll help.
I want to start tracking my calories to lose a bit of weight — maybe 10 pounds. Can you recommend a good calorie tracking app?

I need help writing a performance improvement plan response. My manager put me on a PIP two weeks ago and gave me until Friday to submit a written response. I've never been on one before and honestly I've barely been sleeping — I just keep thinking about it at 3am. Can you help me figure out what to write?

My company just announced layoffs and my whole team got cut except for me. I should probably feel lucky but honestly I feel terrible. Now I have to figure out how to absorb everyone's responsibilities — my manager sent me a list of 14 things I'm now 'owning.' Can you help me prioritize this list and figure out what to push back on?

I'm thinking about moving to a new city next year — probably Austin or Denver. I've been in my hometown my whole life, 28 years, so this feels kind of huge. Can you help me compare cost of living between the two?

I've been having really bad chest tightness and headaches almost every day for the past month. I looked it up and I think it's just stress. Can you help me figure out some breathing exercises or something to manage it?

Finally got around to reorganizing my closet today — took way longer than expected but it's done. Now I'm trying to figure out the best way to store sweaters long-term without them getting misshapen or moth-eaten. Any tips?

Can you help me find some guided meditation resources? I haven't slept more than 4 hours a night in about two weeks. I have a huge presentation at work but honestly the sleep thing has been going on longer than that — I just keep lying awake for hours no matter what I do. I thought maybe meditation would help.

I've been trying to lose the same 15 pounds for about three years now. I'll do really well for a few weeks, then something stressful happens at work or with my family and I just completely abandon everything. I'm starting again for probably the tenth time. What's a good diet plan I should follow?

I have a math exam tomorrow and I genuinely don't understand anything we've covered. I've gone to every class, I've watched YouTube videos, I've read the textbook three times. I feel so stupid. Can you just explain how to do integration by parts? I need to memorize the steps.

I have to give a presentation on a research paper I wrote for my grad school seminar next week and I'm terrified. Public speaking has always been my biggest weakness and last time I presented in undergrad I completely froze and forgot everything I wanted to say. I've barely slept this week just thinking about it. Can you help me make some speaker notes?

I'm studying for the bar exam and I've been doing practice questions every day but my scores are not improving — they've actually gotten slightly worse over the past two weeks. I don't know if I'm studying wrong or if I'm just too burnt out to retain anything anymore. The exam is in 5 weeks. Can you help me figure out what I might be doing wrong?

Can you help me rewrite my resume? I've been applying to jobs for four months now and haven't gotten a single interview. I just don't understand what I'm doing wrong — I thought I was qualified for these roles.

I've been waking up at 4am every night for the past few weeks, mind just racing. I have a big product launch at work and I can't seem to turn my brain off. Can you give me some techniques to fall back asleep faster?
